Hey folks, wanted to share about two meaningful and fun things happening over at Land of the Good (3 min from school) this month: First, we’re hosting a free community potluck event for neurodivergent families, and all are welcome! https://www.hisawyer.com/land-of-the-good/schedules/activity-set/196

Hey folks, wanted to share about two meaningful and fun things happening over at Land of the Good (3 min from school) this month: First, we’re hosting a free community potluck event for neurodivergent families, and all are welcome! https://www.hisawyer.com/land-of-the-good/schedules/activity-set/196

And secondly, if like me and most moms, you are good at lots of things except for prioritizing and taking care of yourself, please join us for Self-Care School. This is a group that meets once a month working on different aspect of self-care with a spa party vibe, and then “self-care homework” exerc
Thanks so much Eloisa! Also, we have a free community gardening activity for seniors and infants and toddlers right after Minimusic everyone is welcome to join.
